cards.subtitle: Deterministic Enterprise 10M-User Personalized CRM Video Synthesis pipeline evaluation (pre-baking 95% of cinematic AI B-roll segments with strict Closed-GOP IDR boundaries and identical SPS/PPS/90kHz headers, rendering only the 5% personalized user-data slot in <180ms via GPU Skia/NVENC, and splicing fMP4 moof+mdat byte streams in <12ms so amortized unit cost c_crm(u) = c_0 / (1 + u) reaches 0.5000 at u = 1.0, locking C_active / C_crm = 1.0000x across all 17 campaign tiers u in [0.000, 1.000] with 0/17 violated) versus naive per-user full 1,800-frame video re-encoding (which redundantly re-encodes 95% shared frames per user, inflating FinOps spend by 1 + u to 1.2500x at T4, 1.5000x at T8, and 2.0000x at T16 across 16/17 tiers) and 64-segment GOP quadrature.

good_fit: Airline, banking, telecom, gaming, and e-commerce Year-in-Review ("Wrapped") personalized videos for 1,000,000 to 10,000,000 members
Combining 95% pre-baked Closed-GOP AI persona B-roll segments with 5% (90-frame) dynamic variable slot NVENC encoding and <12ms fMP4/HLS byte-stream splicing
Lazy Just-in-Time (JIT) synthesis triggered only when a user opens the push notification (~18%~25% open rate), saving 75%+ of idle pre-generation compute
not_for: Re-encoding all 1,800 frames of a 60s video per user when 1,710 frames are shared across cohorts
Pre-rendering 10,000,000 MP4 files upfront for dormant accounts that never open the campaign message
